name: Olympic Cards Limited
about: Olympic Cards Limited manufactures, trades in, and sells cards in India. It offers wedding invitation cards, greeting cards, visiting cards, office envelopes, letter heads, cloth lined covers, student notebooks, account books, files, business cards, calendars, paper/board-based products, etc. The company also trades in screen-offset inks. It offers its products franchisees under the OLYMPIC brand name. The company was formerly known as Olympic Business Credits (Madras) Private Limited and changed its name to Olympic Cards Limited in May 1998. Olympic Cards Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Chennai, India.
